project.name: quality-runner
project.identity: A local-first audit-and-plan quality orchestrator that produces evidence and plans without mutating source code, installing dependencies, or committing changes.
project.audience: Developers and reviewers who need an evidence-backed quality view and safe next plan for a repository or change.
project.core_loop: Inspect repository and task state, compile applicable quality checks, run or collect bounded evidence, distinguish findings from opinion, and produce an explicit review or remediation plan without source mutation.
project.north_star: Quality decisions are more trustworthy because the runner shows what was checked, what was not, why a finding matters, and what safe action follows.
not_this: A commit, merge, or release authority

mvp.definition: A repository task can receive a scoped audit, machine-readable findings, and an actionable plan while preserving the source worktree.

complete_product.definition: Quality Runner provides reliable task-scoped audit, review-delta, cache, security, release, and planning evidence with clear maturity boundaries across supported repositories.

outcomes.name: A quality result distinguishes observed evidence, inferred risk, unknowns, and safe next actions for the exact task scope.

layers.intended: A reviewer can make a calibrated quality decision without confusing configured checks with executed proof.
layers.planned: The repository defines audit, plan, review-delta, cache, release, and security contracts.
layers.implemented: The orchestrator is read-only and produces machine-readable findings and plans.
layers.verified: Repository documentation and local contract behavior establish the read-only boundary; broader provider and release parity was not run here.

evidence.note: Defines the audit-and-plan quality orchestrator and no-mutation boundary.

blockers.summary: Configured or local-only evidence does not by itself establish provider-native, CI, browser, or release proof.

outcomes.name: Quality findings can be consumed by review and release workflows without the runner taking ownership of source mutation, commits, or merges.

layers.intended: The runner informs governed workflows while preserving project ownership and integration gates.
layers.planned: The project explicitly separates audit and plan from mutation and release authority.
layers.implemented: Machine-readable quality outputs and review-oriented contracts exist.
layers.verified: No hosted CI or release projection was run in this bootstrap.

evidence.note: Documents the no-source-mutation and no-commit scope.

blockers.summary: Consumer-specific promotion and release behavior remain separate verification surfaces.

verified.note: Documented read-only claims; no hosted release verification here.

drift.summary: Quality Runner has a strong local read-only contract, but its outputs are not automatically authoritative proof for CI, provider, browser, or release layers.

evidence.note: Defines local audit scope and preserved ownership boundaries.
